title: Darkshore 'Holy Diver' (87760) gives 0 XP on the beta; fixed for launch
claim: Holy Diver (quest 87760, level 20, Darkshore, Alliance) awards 0 XP on beta build 70450; designer Aidan Moon says it should be fixed for launch (issue closed as Fixed Oct 19).
detail: Capstone of the Beached Sea Creatures chain (kill Stormscale Beastmistress for the Rod of Deep Dominion). Nearby level-20 quests give about 1,550-1,950 XP, so expect a normal level-20 reward at launch. Keep it in launch routes; only skip on the beta.

title: Applejack Still repeatable XP (beta exploit) is fixed for launch
claim: On the beta, the Elwynn Forest Applejack Still turn-in (quest 91736, Thunder Falls ~24.5,58.2) could be repeated for XP that scales with level (about 170 XP per turn-in reported; a stream showed 250-350k XP/hour); Aggrend says it is already fixed for launch.
detail: Aggrend (Josh Greenfield) on X, Oct 19: 'Not going to be a thing. Already fixed for launch by our friend @QuestTheLine.' Do not plan routes around repeat apple turn-ins. The first (normal) turn-in for Thunder Applejack may still give its one-time reward. Forum threads 2386853 and 2386879 describe the exploit; the 5-hour 1-60 claim in 2386879 is unverified.

title: Mage: Arcane Missiles does not proc Missile Barrage (removed as too strong)
claim: Arcane Missiles hits do not trigger Missile Barrage (2-point talent) despite the Oct 15 notes; designer Aidan Moon says that was removed in development for being too strong. Separately, a proc consumed with under 1 s left gives an unbuffed 3-missile channel, fixed for launch.
detail: Plan Arcane leveling rotations without self-chaining Missile Barrage from Arcane Missiles: procs come from other spells (Arcane Blast etc.). Issues #405 (closed not planned) and #397 (closed fixed for launch). Zockify's 70450 changelog lists Frost Blast among Missile Barrage triggers (10/20%), but its diffs look reversed against foreverchanges, so that part is unconfirmed.

title: Thrown weapons: first throw will wind up 0.5 s, not weapon speed (fix for launch)
claim: On beta build 70450 the first throw on a target winds up for the throwing weapon's full speed (e.g. 2.0 s); designer Aidan Moon says this will be fixed for launch so it matches wands (0.5 s).
detail: Matters for Warrior/Rogue pulls with throwing weapons. Bows, guns and crossbows keep the weapon-speed windup plus the 0.5 s stand-still rule (n:20261017-wand-autoshot-stand-still).

title: Rage from incoming damage: spell-level and Defensive Stance anomalies (bug report)
claim: A combat-log study reports that rage from incoming spell damage is scaled by the spell's level instead of the caster's, that mana-using (paladin-class) NPCs give 40-45% less rage than expected, and that Defensive Stance cuts all rage from incoming damage by 10%; a designer asked for test cases.
detail: Reported to have changed between Oct 7 and Oct 10 builds. Tested mobs: 212, 485, 544, 578 (warrior), 545, 4028 (paladin), spells from 203/441/544. If confirmed, questing Warriors/Druids get less rage when pulling caster-type mobs and in Defensive Stance. Not confirmed by Blizzard yet.

title: Some quest items drop once per group kill (Frosthowl, An Old History Book)
claim: On build 70450, in a 2-player group Frosthowl (quest 98326, Grizzled Den, Dun Morogh) drops only one Gretta's Sack of Fish per kill, and An Old History Book (item 2794, starts quest 337, from Duskwood Flesh Eaters) drops for only one member.
detail: Reporter says the Sack of Fish dropped for every member earlier in the beta. With the official round-robin rule for group quest drops (n:20261012-group-quest-drop-round-robin), a duo needs two Frosthowl kills. Plan duo routes accordingly until Blizzard answers.

title: Racial base stats use modern offsets, not Classic (bug report)
claim: Naked level-1 Warriors of every race show modern (Midnight) racial stat offsets vs Human (23/20/22/20/20): Orc +3 Str/-3 Agi/+1 Sta/-1 Int/0 Spi (Classic +3/-3/+2/-3/+3), Dwarf +2/-2/+1/-1/0, Night Elf -2/+2/0/0/0 (Classic -3/+5/-1/0/0).
detail: Small leveling effect (a few points of Str/Agi/Spi early on). Open issue, pending approval; no Blizzard answer yet.

title: Layering: leaving a group or crossing some zone borders swaps your layer
claim: In Forever, leaving a group moves the leaver to a new layer and also moves the group leader; crossing some zone borders (Dalaran-Silverpine Forest, Tirisfal Glades-Ruins of Lordaeron) can swap layers; a warning appears before a swap.
detail: Commenters add swaps on relog while grouped, quest mobs vanishing when joining a group, and buffs/campfire sessions lost on a swap. Developer Tim Jones (podcast) said layering is a work in progress with incremental changes. Related: n:20261013-world-refresh-layer-switch.

title: Leveling past 30: Riverglades (path from Redridge) and Mount Hyjal
claim: Blizzard's 'Your Leveling Journey Past 30' video (Oct 19) names Riverglades and Mount Hyjal as 30-60 zones; Icy Veins says Alliance reach Riverglades by a new path from Redridge Mountains, with the Alliance hub at Farhold Keep and Horde allied with the Boulderrock ogres; Hyjal is the end of the leveling journey.
detail: Riverglades also has Krol'dok Stronghold (Twilight's Hammer, outdoor elite area), a pirate chain, a horse escort and an ogre fighting ring (Bloodmaster's Ring). No level ranges were given. Hyjal holds the 10-player raid Barrow Deeps. Riverglades is also reached by the neutral Tanaris boat (n:20261014-riverglades-boat-tanaris). The Redridge path is per Icy Veins only.

title: Dalaran -> Stormwind portal for Alliance Skyborne is gone since Oct 15
claim: The Dalaran-Stormwind portal that only Alliance Skyborne could use is missing since the Oct 15 build; a bug report and a forum thread (Oct 19) both report it, with no Blizzard reply yet.
detail: Alliance Skyborne leaving Dalaran must use hearth, flight paths or the Southshore boat. Mage teleports aren't available below 30. Issue #380 is still open.
